We’ve worked side by side on SentinelX’s cloud security platform for over two years, collaborating daily on product roadmap alignment and cross-functional coordination. Sebastian’s approach to product management is grounded in clarity and collaboration—whether refining feature priorities or translating stakeholder needs into actionable tasks, he consistently bridges gaps without micromanaging.  

On a typical day, you’ll find him deep in sprint planning, ensuring team workflows stay aligned with market demands. His competitive analysis skills shine during quarterly reviews, where he spotlights emerging threats and positions our solutions to stay ahead. Managing stakeholder expectations is second nature; he balances technical rigor with business acumen, keeping everyone focused on shared goals.  

One standout moment came when he led a high-stakes redesign of our incident response dashboard. By integrating user feedback and simplifying complex workflows, he reduced onboarding time by 30% without compromising security depth. Another was navigating a roadmap conflict between engineering and sales—his ability to synthesize data and advocate for a balanced approach kept the team moving forward.  

Sebastian’s work ethic is unmatched. He’ll stay late to resolve blockers or volunteer for high-impact tasks, always prioritizing the product’s long-term value over short-term wins. I’d confidently recommend him for any role requiring strategic thinking, stakeholder alignment, and a relentless focus on delivering real-world impact.
